newsitem.title: USA: ThermoQuest buys two companies for $26.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: ThermoQuest buys two companies for $26.4 mln.

text.p: ThermoQuest Corp said Wedneday it has acquired CE Instruments and MassLab Instruments from their parent, Thermo Instrument Systems Inc for $26.4 million.
ThermoQuest said it has purchased CE Instruments for $19.8 million, and MassLab for $6.6 million. In addition, ThermoQuest said it will assume $8.9 million in debts of CE Instruments.
The two companies originally were part of the scientific instruments division of Fisons Plc. They were acquired by Thermo Instrument in March.
CE Instruments is near Milan, Italy. MassLab Instruments is near Manchester, England.
ThermoQuest develops, manufactures and sells mass spectrometers, liquid chromatographs and gas chromatographs for the environmental, pharmaceutical and industrial marketplaces.
